context: Tests the --full flag: parallel expansion reads, artifact summaries, and that saved tasks stay informational.

checklist.name: Flag detected
checklist.description: Recognises `--full` in the arguments and runs the expansion phase

checklist.name: Expansion reads are parallel
checklist.description: The tasks.md, hot-file and manifest reads go out in one message

checklist.name: Top 3 hot files only
checklist.description: Reads at most three hot files, not all of them

checklist.name: Artifacts read
checklist.description: Reads the two files listed under `## Thinking Artifacts`

checklist.name: Artifact summaries included
checklist.description: Report includes a brief summary of each artifact

checklist.name: Tasks not restored
checklist.description: Does not recreate or start any saved task

checklist.name: Informational note
checklist.description: States that task data is shown as information only

checklist.name: Richer than default
checklist.description: Report has expansion sections a default load would not

checklist.name: Few round trips
checklist.description: Completes without one file per message
